base.derivation: admin pick (preset or color input); near-black (luminance < 0.012) lifted 14% toward white

ink.derivation: inkFor(base, [base, face-top, face-bottom]): base hue deepened until >= 4.5:1 on all three

ink-soft.derivation: softInkFor: ink pulled toward base while >= 4.5:1 on all surfaces

amber.derivation: fixed; admin panel only (unsaved / busy LED)

themeDerivation.presetDefaults: radius 14px, depth 0.7 (public); admin panel plate: Kapur, radius 12px, depth 0.6 (hi #edeff1, lo #c4c7ca)

label.purpose: Admin field labels, legends, buttons, switches, status.

shadows.name: bevel

shadows.name: rim

shadows.name: led-glow

narrative.overview:
The public page is one piece of audio equipment sitting on a desk. It is a single molded plastic or anodized slab, lit from the top left, with a speaker grille, the owner's avatar seated as a driver cone, four screws, a column of preset keys with indicator LEDs, small round tact switches for socials, and a power lamp at the foot. The base is neumorphic: every surface is the same material, pushed out or pressed in. Skeuomorphic hardware details give the visitor objects they recognize as buttons, so the page never looks like a stack of identical pills on a gradient.

The admin editor uses the same world as a service panel. Faders stand in for range inputs, slide switches with LEDs for checkboxes, segmented keys for radios, small preset keys for color swatches, and the live faceplate preview is pinned beside them. On the admin side clarity beats costume: the hardware vocabulary shows up as tactile shape and depth, never as decorative texture.

Everything is derived at runtime. The admin picks two colors (a base material and an LED color) plus radius, depth, font, and key style. themeVars() in src/lib/site.ts computes every other shade from those picks, so a choice the admin makes cannot break contrast. The token values in this file are the default Kapur preset at depth 0.7.
keyCharacteristics: One material per unit; every shade is a mix of the base toward white or black.
Light comes from the top left: a highlight shadow up-left, a dark shadow down-right, and a 1px bevel on raised parts.
State lives in LEDs and in press depth. Hue changes never carry state on their own.
Label-first keys: LED, glyph, label, arrow, in that order.
Text clears 4.5:1 on every surface it can sit on, enforced in code.

rules.name: The One Material Rule
rules.body: No color is picked by hand except base and LED. Every other value comes from themeVars(): light = luminance(base) > 0.18; face-top mixes base toward white by 22% (6% on dark bases); face-bottom mixes toward black by 3% (12% dark); ground mixes toward black by 7% (32% dark); hi mixes toward white by 75%×depth (10%×depth dark); lo mixes toward black by 20%×depth (55%×depth dark); led-off mixes toward black by 16% (35% dark). A near-black base (luminance < 0.012) is first lifted 14% toward white so it can still cast a darker shadow.

rules.name: The Ink Floor Rule
rules.body: Ink is the base hue darkened (or lightened, on dark plastics) until it clears 4.5:1 against base, face-top, and face-bottom together. Soft ink is ink pulled back toward the base only as far as 4.5:1 still holds. New text roles take one of these two inks. Never add a third grey.

rules.name: The Panel Isolation Rule
rules.body: Admin chrome uses a fixed Kapur plate (radius 12, depth 0.6). The admin's draft colors appear only inside the preview.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: Every key reads label-first in sentence case. Do not use uppercase tracking, eyebrow kickers, or small caps.

rules.name: The 16px Input Rule
rules.body: Form controls never go below 16px (max(16px, 1em)), so iOS does not zoom the page.

rules.name: The Press Flip Rule
rules.body: Pressing a control moves it 1–2px down and swaps its raise shadow for press over 90ms (keys, tacts) or 120ms (admin buttons). A selected swatch key stays pressed in.

rules.name: The Top-Left Light Rule
rules.body: Highlights always sit up-left and shade down-right. Never invert or rotate the light source for one component.

dos: Do derive every new color from base and LED through themeVars() and mix(). Kapur values are examples. They are not constants.
Do build new controls as raised or pressed parts of the same material, lit from the top left, with the bevel on raised parts.
Do keep a native input under every hardware-styled control, and keep every touch target at least 44px.
Do show state with an LED and with press depth, and mirror it in text or ARIA (switch LED plus checked state, lit key plus "(utama)").
Do honor prefers-contrast: more: add 1px soft-ink outlines to raised parts, switch soft text to full ink, and ring the lit LED.
Do keep press feedback at 90–140ms with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), and turn transitions off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add borders, colored or tinted shadows, or a second accent hue on the faceplate.
Don't fill a key or put text on the LED color. LED is light only. Text stays in ink or soft ink.
Don't let the admin's draft colors leak into editor chrome.
Don't stretch the unit beyond 440px or turn the keys into a full-width list on desktop.
Don't add uppercase eyebrows or kickers above names, headings, or panels.
